tool_args.rationale: All five observations are at H ≤ 0.48, far short of the target H = 20.3. The slow-horizon probe tests whether the positive short-window response weakens or reverses and helps distinguish slow adaptation amplitude from its timescale.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At the pilot horizons, slow adaptation mainly constrains the ratio of its amplitude to its timescale. Fits that agree there can diverge at H = 20.3.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon adaptation without a sink term
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: This omits the observed sink-gradient dependence and leaves the slow timescale weakly constrained.
Finer trajectory sampling does not directly resolve the long-horizon ambiguity.
